_source.title: 设置扩展所有用户配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 此举会覆盖当前扩展的所有用户配置信息，请谨慎操作
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.example.text.0: 1. 备份当前全部配置（整体覆盖前必做）
_source.example.text.1: 2. 整体写入一份新配置，原有配置被覆盖
_source.example.text.2: 3. 把备份的原配置写回，还原存储现场

title: Set all user configurations of the extension
remarks.text.0: This will overwrite all user configuration information of the current extension. Please operate with caution
remarks.text.1: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
params.configs: All user configurations of the extension
